message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"Three distinct risks are clearly disclosed in DoorDash's Risk Factors Summary and are explicitly stated in the provided passages.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"1) Limited operating history in an evolving industry makes it difficult to evaluate future prospects and increases risk of not being successful.","passage_rank":2,"quote":"We have a limited operating history in an evolving industry, which makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and may increase the risk that we will not be successful;"} ,{"requirement":"2) History of net losses with anticipated rising expenses and potential inability to maintain or increase profitability.","passage_rank":2,"quote":"We have a history of net losses, we anticipate increasing expenses in the future, and we may not be able to maintain or increase profitability in the future;"} ,{"requirement":"3) Dashers reclassified as employees could adversely affect the business, financial condition, and results of operations.","passage_rank":2,"quote":"If Dashers are reclassified as employees under federal or state law, our business, financial condition, and results of operations would be adversely affected;"}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
